title: 第21章 清灵公主之死第22章 踏雪无痕修炼体系
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
纤细的身影掠过宫墙，足尖点在琉璃瓦上面，竟然没有发出半点儿声响。
不用多说，这道身影应该也是被传言所骗，以为夏无恙已经拿到了所有的龙虎大药和天水精华，准备做一次梁上君子。
从其一举一动当中，就能够看得出来这道身影的主人乃是一个女子，并且身材极好。
夜空中划过一抹优美的弧线，落在了文华殿的飞檐之上。
轻风不经意间吹起她的面纱，露出了一张倾国倾城的绝色容颜。
肌肤胜雪，杏眼含春，樱唇不点而红。
玄色的夜行衣包裹着娇躯，将玲珑的曲线勾勒得淋漓尽致，腰间束着黑色的软带，随着她的动作泛起冷光。
“已经快要入土的老东西，怎么有资格使用天水精华，就连那些龙虎大药，交给他也是浪费了。”
潜入文华殿的时候，低低的声音响起，带着毫不掩饰的轻蔑和厌恶。
练功室中，通过心灵力场，夏无恙第一时间察觉到了异常。
顾不得修行，无声无息地离开练功室，回到了锦榻之上，左拥右抱，醉生梦死，似乎一直都在这里躺着。
曼妙身影出现在寝殿的时候，看到的就是夏无恙跟数名绝色大被同眠的画面，精致的俏脸上满是不屑，稍作观察以后，就在文华殿中寻找起来。
素手翻飞，一点点搜查过去，不知不觉中就把文华殿搜查了大半，却仅仅找到几瓶龙虎大药，并没有找到天水精华的下落，而她这次最大的目标就是天水精华。
肆意搜寻的身影并不知道，看似昏睡的老太子已经发动了摄魂术，探查到了她浅层的记忆和想法。
“原来是她……可惜不是她妹妹！”
夏无恙放心了一些，悄悄打开床头的玉匣，让里面的丹药香气飘散出去。
“咦……”
曼妙身影鼻翼微动，嗅闻到一股若有若无的药香从锦榻那边传来。
锦帐低垂，隐隐约约能够看到那个苍老身影沉睡其中，不知道身在何处。
曼妙身影嘴角勾起一抹讥嘲之色，目光落在了枕头下面的玉匣上面：“莫非是在哪儿。”

无声无息靠近过去，曼妙身影伸手准备去抓玉匣。
注意力全部在玉匣上面的曼妙身影丝毫没有察觉到，一双铁手也在无声无息朝着她靠近过来，她也未曾想到，夏无恙居然有实力对她出手。
就在她抓到玉匣的瞬间，感觉到自己脖颈上多了一双铁手，死死地钳着她光洁如玉的脖颈，让她连丝毫反抗之力都没有。
“你……你不是废人！”
曼妙身影骇然地看着面前陡然睁开眼睛的老太子，哪还有半点儿昏聩老态：“太子哥哥饶命，我知道错了，求求您饶了我一次，妹妹下次再也不敢了！”
“呵呵……晚了！”
content_en:
The slender figure passed over the palace wall, and her toes touched the glazed tiles without making any sound.
Needless to say, this figure must have been deceived by the rumors, thinking that Xia Wuyang had obtained all the dragon and tiger elixirs and the essence of Tianshui, and was preparing to become a gentleman in Liang Shang.
From every move, it can be seen that the owner of this figure is a woman, and she has an excellent figure.
A graceful arc drew in the night sky and landed on the eaves of Wenhua Hall.
The breeze inadvertently blew up her veil, revealing a stunning face that would captivate the entire country.
Her skin is as beautiful as snow, her almond-shaped eyes are full of spring, and her cherry lips are red without any spots.
The black night clothes wrapped her delicate body and outlined her exquisite curves vividly. There was a soft black belt around her waist, which glowed with cold light as she moved.
"How can an old man who is about to be buried be qualified to use the essence of Tianshui? Even those dragon and tiger medicines would be a waste if given to him."
When sneaking into the Wenhua Hall, a low voice sounded, with undisguised contempt and disgust.
In the practice room, through the spiritual force field, Xia Wuyang immediately noticed the abnormality.
Regardless of his practice, he left the practice room silently and returned to the brocade couch, hugging him from left to right, drunk and dreaming, as if he had been lying here all the time.
When the graceful figure appeared in the dormitory, what he saw was Xia Wuyang sleeping with several stunning beauties. His delicate and pretty face was full of disdain. After a short observation, he started looking for her in the Wenhua Palace.
With her bare hands flying, she searched little by little, and unknowingly searched most of the Wenhua Palace, but only found a few bottles of Dragon and Tiger Medicine, but not the whereabouts of Tianshui Essence, and her biggest target this time was Tianshui Essence.
The figure who was searching wantonly didn't know that the seemingly sleepy old lady had already activated the soul-stirring technique and explored her shallow memories and thoughts.
"It turns out it's her... but it's a pity it's not her sister!"
Xia Wuyang felt relieved and quietly opened the jade box beside the bed, letting the aroma of the elixir inside spread out.
"Eh..."
The graceful figure's nose moved slightly, and she smelled a vague medicinal fragrance coming from the brocade couch.
The brocade tent was hung low, and the old figure could be vaguely seen sleeping in it, not knowing where he was.
There was a hint of ridicule on the lips of the graceful figure, and her eyes fell on the jade box under the pillow: "Could it be somewhere?"
Approaching silently, the graceful figure reached out to grab the jade box.
The graceful figure who was focusing all her attention on the jade box did not notice at all that a pair of iron hands were silently approaching her. She never thought that Xia Wuyang had the strength to attack her.
The moment she grabbed the jade box, she felt a pair of iron hands on her neck, clamping tightly on her smooth and jade-like neck, leaving her unable to resist at all.
"You...you are not a useless person!"
The graceful figure looked in horror at the old prince who suddenly opened his eyes in front of him. He was still a bit drowsy and old-fashioned: "Brother Prince, please forgive me. I know I was wrong. Please forgive me once. My sister will never dare to do it again next time!"
"Haha...it's too late!"
